name: What documents should a homeowner prepare before applying for remodeling permits?

mainEntity.name: What documents should a homeowner prepare before applying for remodeling permits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners should gather existing architectural floor plans, HOA guidelines, and property surveys before beginning the permit submission process. If your home belongs to a homeowners association, obtaining HOA architectural review approval is often a prerequisite before municipal permits are approved. Having these documents ready early lets our team finalize framing plans, outline plumbing routes, and submit complete documentation on the first attempt without administrative delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather existing floor plans, property surveys, and any HOA architectural guidelines. Having these ready helps ensure prompt submission and approval by your local building department.
